import numpy as np
import json

# Load all data
data_r3 = np.load("/work/fwd/r3/run.npz")
data_r4 = np.load("/work/fwd/r4/run.npz")
l0_mlp = data_r3["L0_MLP"]

pos_sens = float(np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[0, 2] - l0_mlp[0, 3]))
tok_sens = float(np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[0, 2] - l0_mlp[2, 2]))

print(f"pos_sens={pos_sens:.4f}, tok_sens={tok_sens:.4f}")

if pos_sens > 0.05 and tok_sens > 0.05:
    tag = "COMBINER"
    hyp = "L0_MLP combines two distinct sources (position from W_pos and token from W_E) at each position to produce its output."
elif pos_sens > 0.05 and tok_sens <= 0.05:
    tag = "INDICATOR"
    hyp = "L0_MLP detects position identity (is this position 2?) from the position embedding and emits a binary-like gate signal."
elif pos_sens <= 0.05 and tok_sens > 0.05:
    tag = "MAPPER"
    hyp = "L0_MLP transforms the token at its own position independently into a non-binary output."
else:
    tag = "INDICATOR"
    hyp = "L0_MLP emits a near-constant signal independent of both token and position."

print(f"Tag: {tag}")
print(f"Hyp: {hyp}")

result = {
    "tags": {"L0_MLP": tag},
    "evidence": {
        "L0_MLP": {
            "hypothesis": hyp,
            "test": "r4",
            "supports": True
        }
    }
}

with open("/work/submission.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(result, f, indent=2)

print("\nSubmission written.")
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

import numpy as np

data = np.load("/work/fwd/r3/run.npz")
l0_mlp = data["L0_MLP"]

# r3 inputs: 0=all7, 1=all3, 2=(pos2=3,rest=7), 3=(pos2=5,rest=7), 4=example1, 5=example2

print("Position sensitivity (input 0: all 7s):")
for p in range(10):
    print(f"  pos {p}: {l0_mlp[0, p].round(3)}")

print("\nToken sensitivity at pos 2 (rest=7, pos2 varies 7/3/5):")
print(f"  token=7: {l0_mlp[0, 2].round(4)}")
print(f"  token=3: {l0_mlp[2, 2].round(4)}")
print(f"  token=5: {l0_mlp[3, 2].round(4)}")

tok_diff = np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[0, 2] - l0_mlp[2, 2])
pos_diff = np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[0, 2] - l0_mlp[0, 3])
print(f"\nToken diff norm (pos2 token 7 vs 3): {tok_diff:.4f}")
print(f"Position diff norm (pos2 vs pos3, same token 7): {pos_diff:.4f}")

print("\nRouting test - does L0_MLP at pos3 change when pos2 token changes?")
rout_diff = np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[0, 3] - l0_mlp[2, 3])
print(f"  pos3 when pos2=7: {l0_mlp[0, 3].round(4)}")
print(f"  pos3 when pos2=3: {l0_mlp[2, 3].round(4)}")
print(f"  Routing diff: {rout_diff:.4f}")

import numpy as np

data = np.load("/work/fwd/r3/run.npz")
l0_mlp = data["L0_MLP"]

# Check if token at pos 3 affects L0_MLP at pos 3
# Input 0: all 7s (pos3=7); Input 1: all 3s (pos3=3)
# Since routing diff=0, only pos3 token should matter
print("L0_MLP at pos3 for different tokens at pos3:")
print(f"  all 7s (pos3=7): {l0_mlp[0, 3].round(4)}")
print(f"  all 3s (pos3=3): {l0_mlp[1, 3].round(4)}")
tok3_diff = np.linalg.norm(l0_mlp[0, 3] - l0_mlp[1, 3])
print(f"  Diff: {tok3_diff:.4f}")

# Check pos2 token sensitivity for different base contexts

    print(f"  pos {p}: diff={d:.2f}")
